coordinateSpace: Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in FULL-RESOLUTION UPRIGHT page pixels after rotating the scan 90 degrees clockwise. x: 0..5100 (left printed page 0..2550, right printed page 2550..5100), y: 0..3510. Half-open: pixel x1/y1 excluded. Read coordinates directly off the labeled grid sheets in tmp/verify/environment/asset-work/grid/.

verification.boundsProvenance: Proposed by Agy (Gemini 4, image input) against the actual scans; independently reviewed by root (GPT, image input) on all 5 source grids and a first-contact comparison. No human has approved these crops; final original-resolution contact-44 review is pending.
verification.exclusionPolicy: Document-art clipping rectangles (paper fill #dbdcdb) only, outside subject art: rauduskoivu (text above leaf inset; left edge refined to x=1260 preview by root after the first mask clipped canopy), hirvi (card number/title strip left of antlers), peippo (three text strips). Season/sex annotations (kesa/talvi, male symbols) stay: original scientific annotations, not species answers.
verification.protocol: 1) This applier verified preview scale from actual preview headers. 2) build_nature_crops.py --self-test/--dry-run, then guarded serial build. 3) root/Agy inspect contact-44 at native resolution plus the exclusion spot-check pairs (unmasked/masked) before any verified status or commit.

finalOutputVisualReview.result: All 44 show intended species art, no species-name answer labels; exclusion rectangles preserve canopy/leaf inset (rauduskoivu), antlers/body (hirvi), and head/beak/feet (peippo). Season labels (kesa/talvi) and sex symbols explicitly accepted.

cropRules.mustContain: Only the single species' own illustration art. Trees may include their leaf/cone detail art when it is part of the same illustration region.
cropRules.anatomy: Complete bodies: antennae, tails, legs, leaf tips. No clipping.
cropRules.rejectIf: box smaller than 150x150 full-res px; box outside page; output long edge under 300px (unless --allow-small); box touches page edge (warn - possible clipping)
